nodes.label: SEAD MCP Server (sead.pg)
nodes.source_file: docs/MCP Server/SEAD Reconciliation via MCP — Architecture Doc (Outline).md
nodes.rationale: Standardized connector between FastAPI and SEAD retrieval. Read-only, minimal API surface with resources (lookup_tables, lookup_rows) and tools (search_lookup, get_by_id, optional rerank). Bearer token auth with read-only DB role.

nodes.label: search_lookup Tool
nodes.source_file: docs/MCP Server/SEAD Reconciliation via MCP — Architecture Doc (Outline).md
nodes.rationale: Essential MCP tool for hybrid retrieval over a single table. Returns compact scored candidates with raw_scores (trgm, sem, blend). Defaults: k_fuzzy=30, k_sem=30, k_final=20, active_only=true.

nodes.label: rerank Tool
nodes.source_file: docs/MCP Server/SEAD Reconciliation via MCP — Architecture Doc (Outline).md
nodes.rationale: Optional cross-encoder scoring on small candidate set from search_lookup. Returns sorted results with scores. Model: bge-reranker-base@onnx. Timeout budget: 120ms.

nodes.label: get_by_id Tool
nodes.source_file: docs/MCP Server/SEAD Reconciliation via MCP — Architecture Doc (Outline).md
nodes.rationale: Single-row fetch for preview/audit. Returns id, value, aliases, language, active, and provenance metadata.

nodes.label: Hybrid Retrieval Logic
nodes.source_file: docs/MCP Server/SEAD Reconciliation via MCP — Architecture Doc (Outline).md
nodes.rationale: Normalize (lowercase, de-accent, trim) → pg_trgm top 30 + pgvector top 30 → union, de-dup → weighted blend (0.5/0.5) → keep 15-20 → optional cross-encoder rerank to top-5. Filters: language, active rows, domain tags.

nodes.label: RAG Pipeline (MCP-based)
nodes.source_file: docs/MCP Server/SEAD Reconciliation via MCP — Architecture Doc (Outline).md
nodes.rationale: Data flow: OpenRefine → FastAPI → MCP search_lookup → (optional rerank) → LLM (context + top candidates) → strict JSON → OpenRefine. Goal: tiny prompts, canonical IDs, <900ms p95.
